description: Phase 3 — Component composition with PER-INSTANCE hydration identity. Resolve custom tags against manifest.deps; recursively compile child instances with parent->child props; project parent content into child slots; isolate scoped CSS via repo-relative child scopeIds; detect dependency cycles. N instances of a component each own their state/root/emit/rerender, keyed by a per-instance data-adx-i discriminator and three-part hook ids via instanceBindingId. Depends on FEAT-001 (resolveProps 'composed' + runSetup) and FEAT-002 (compilePage, scopeLocation, repoRoot).
steps: Create src/codegen/html-tags.ts exporting a curated Set of standard HTML tag names (the 'known HTML element' allowlist). Add additive instanceBindingId(scope, instanceIndex, n): `${scope}-i${instanceIndex}-${n}` to src/codegen/scope.ts (leave bindingId/scopeId unchanged). Export both from src/index.ts.

Extend src/codegen/context.ts: alongside mergedProps add an INSTANCES accumulator (one record per emitted instance: { instanceIndex, props }) and a shared page-global instance-ordinal counter owned by the top-level build; thread the counter through compileComponent (src/compile.ts) and compilePage (src/page/compile.ts) so ordinals are unique across a whole page.

In src/codegen/html.ts (optionally extracting src/codegen/compose.ts called by emitHtml): build a dep-resolution table once per component — for each manifest.deps dir load its manifest and index it by kebab(manifest.name) and by the dep directory basename, resolving deps relative to the using component's dir. When an element's tag is not in the HTML allowlist and not 'slot': if it resolves via deps, compose it; else throw `[ADX] structure.adx:<line> - Unknown component "<tag>" (not an HTML element; add to manifest deps)`. A manifest dep that is missing/uncompilable throws `[ADX] manifest.json - Dependency not found: "<dep>"`.

Implement emitComponentInstance(dir, props, projected, stack) invoked when the emitter hits a resolved custom tag: evaluate the custom element's :prop bindings and plain attrs against the PARENT scope to build concrete child props; run resolveProps(childManifest, childProps, 'composed') + runSetup(childSrc, mergedChildProps, childBehavior); parse child structure; emit the child body with the child's OWN scopeId computed via scopeLocation(repoRoot, childAbsDir); assign the next instance ordinal; stamp data-adx-i="i<ordinal>" on each top-level owned element of the instance (no speculative wrapper); use instanceBindingId(scope, ordinal, n) for every data-adx-b. Splice the child body in place of the custom tag. Dedupe each child's CSS and glue by resolved ABSOLUTE dir (emit once per distinct component). Record each instance in the INSTANCES accumulator with its mergedProps.

Cycle detection: thread stack: string[] of absolute dirs currently compiling; before recursing, if the child's absolute dir is already in stack throw `[ADX] structure.adx:<line> - Dependency cycle: a -> b -> a` (chain = stack joined by ' -> ', line = the custom tag's line). Direct self-dependency is caught the same way. A visited-set dedupes CSS/glue across the DAG.

Slot projection: child declares named slots with the unchanged `<slot actions />` form (first bare attr is the name; `<slot name="actions"/>` still errors). Parent projects with `<template slot="name">...</template>`; bare non-template direct children and a `<template>` with no slot attr -> default slot. Build projected: Map<slotName, Node[]> from the custom element's children; whitespace-only text between templates is ignored; a self-closing custom element projects nothing. Fatal: two `<template slot="x">` targeting the same named slot -> `[ADX] structure.adx:<line> - Duplicate slot content for "x"` (line = 2nd template); a slot="x" the child does not declare -> `[ADX] structure.adx:<line> - Component "<tag>" has no slot "x"`. At the child's <slot> position emit the projected nodes under the PARENT's scopeId, the PARENT's instance ordinal (data-adx-i), and the PARENT's instance-scoped hook ids (invoke the parent's emit pass / EmitState there) — projected nodes are parent-owned for CSS and hydration; only their DOM position is the child's. Drop the data-adx-slot placeholder in composed output (it appears only in standalone compilation).

Rewrite src/codegen/glue.ts emitGlue to emit, per distinct component, an INSTANCES array (each { i: "i<ordinal>", props: <that instance's mergedProps> }) and a module that loops over instances: each iteration selects its root via document.querySelector('[data-adx-c="SCOPE"][data-adx-i="i<ordinal>"]'), builds its OWN state = setup(Object.assign({}, inst.props, overrides)), its OWN emit closure dispatching a bubbling CustomEvent on that root, a byHook scoped to that root (substituting inst.i into each hook id's {i} template plus a root.matches check), and wires each event as (event)=>{ globalThis.emit = emit; handler(state, event); rerender(); }. HANDLERS is a build-time map of handlerName->imported fn emitted once. Keep evalExpr/applyUpdate/toText as shared pure module-level helpers; the rerender body may iterate the (still-empty until FEAT-004) updates. For the single-component M1 build there is exactly one instance i0.

Update existing tests affected by the id change (hook ids become `${scope}-i0-${n}` and the glue is now per-instance): test/html-emit.test.ts and test/glue-emit.test.ts and any fixture-based snapshot assertions. Add test/compose.test.ts (jsdom): a page composing site-header (default slot) + user-card (slot="actions") — child content appears inside parent markup, each component's data-adx-c is its own id, both CSS blocks appear once and scoped, zero '{{'; a page using one component twice with different data -> distinct data-adx-b and data-adx-i per instance and dispatching an event on each patches that instance only (HIGH-1); a child that emits on click used twice -> clicking the SECOND instance delivers the event with event.target inside the second instance's data-adx-i="i1" subtree (HIGH-2); projected `{{parentState}}` + @event carries the PARENT's data-adx-c/data-adx-i and is wired by the parent (MEDIUM-3). Add unit tests for the dep-resolution table and 2- and 3-node cycle detection.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run build` tsc-clean and `npm test` green including the updated html/glue tests and the new composition suites.

A composed child's markup is spliced inside the parent with the child carrying its own data-adx-c; both components' scoped CSS appear exactly once and never cross-talk even for same-basename deps in different folders (repo-relative scopeId).

The same component used N times emits N roots with distinct data-adx-i and instance-scoped data-adx-b ids; the per-instance glue hydrates each with its own setup(props)->state and patches/dispatches events only within that instance's root.
A child emit from the Nth instance dispatches on the Nth instance's root (correct event.target ancestry for a parent listener).
Projected slot nodes carry the parent's scopeId/instance ordinal/hook ids and are wired/patched by the parent's glue; the child's glue never touches them.
A dependency cycle and an unknown/undeclared slot/tag each fail with their exact `[ADX] structure.adx:<line> - ...` messages.
findings:
SHIPPED. New modules: src/codegen/html-tags.ts (HTML_TAGS set + isHtmlTag) and src/codegen/compose.ts (createBuild + emitComponentInstance + dep table + slot projection + cycle detection). scope.ts gained instanceBindingId(scope,i,n)=`${scope}-i${i}-${n}` (additive; bindingId/scopeId unchanged). All exported from src/index.ts.

KEY CROSS-FEATURE NOTES FOR FEAT-004 (reactivity) + FEAT-006 (docs):
- CodegenContext gained TWO new REQUIRED fields: instanceIndex:number (the i<ordinal> stamped on this emit) and absDir:string (resolved abs dir; dedupe/cycle key). ANY code/test building a CodegenContext literal MUST supply both. test/helpers.ts makeCtx now sets instanceIndex:0 + absDir:fixtureDir.
- BindingHook gained n:number (the per-instance node index). The glue rebuilds each hook's live id per instance as `${SCOPE}-${inst.i}-${n}` (do NOT rely on hook.id across instances — it is only the FIRST instance's resolved id, kept for back-compat/debug). FEAT-004 must attach its `updates` to the hook record and read them in the glue's rerender loop (the loop + `applyUpdate(el,u,state)` stub are already wired; applyUpdate is a shared pure module-level no-op awaiting FEAT-004).
- context.ts now also defines BuildState (page-global accumulator: nextInstanceIndex counter, distinct Map<absDir,DistinctComponent>, order[], cycleStack[], repoRoot, tokensPath, compose()), DistinctComponent, InstanceRecord, and EmitParent. CompileOptions gained internal `build?: BuildState` — compilePage passes ONE shared build so instance ordinals/dedupe/cycle span the whole page; compileInstance creates its own when omitted.
- Instance ordinals: compileInstance assigns the top component its ordinal BEFORE emitHtml (so a standalone/page top component is i0 / i<k>), then composed children get the next ordinals DURING emission. A page with site-header+user-card => i0(header), i1(card); the compose/landing fixture => i0(parent Landing), i1(site-header), i2(user-card).
- Cycle detection: compileInstance pushes its OWN absDir onto build.cycleStack around emitHtml (so the chain starts at the top-level component), and emitComponentInstance pushes each child dir before recursing. Chain = cycleStack(basenames) + childBasename joined ' -> '. Direct self-dep (`deps:['./']` + `<self/>`) => `self -> self`.
- PER-INSTANCE glue is now in src/codegen/glue.ts emitComponentGlue(distinct, importPath) — the SINGLE source of per-instance glue for BOTH paths. emitGlue(hooks,ctx) (single-component) wraps the top component into a 1-instance (i0) DistinctComponent and calls it with './behavior.js'; still exports {state,props} (the LAST instance's) for the hydrate-parity test. page/compile.ts's old local emitComponentGlue/wireHook were DELETED; it now imports emitComponentGlue and passes './<stem>.behavior.js'. The glue: carries INSTANCES[{i:'i<k>',props}], HOOKS[{n,events}], HANDLERS map; loops per instance selecting root by [data-adx-c=SCOPE][data-adx-i=iK], builds own state=setup(props), own emit closure on that root, byHook scoped to root (root.matches + root.querySelector) rebuilding ids from SCOPE+inst.i+n, wires (event)=>{globalThis.emit=emit; handler(state,event); rerender();}.
- Slot projection: child declares `<slot name/>` (unchanged); parent projects `<template slot="name">...` (default slot = bare children / template w/o slot attr / non-template children; whitespace-only text ignored; self-closing custom tag projects nothing). Projected nodes are PARENT-OWNED: emitted via the parent's EmitState (makeEmitParent) so they carry the PARENT's data-adx-c + data-adx-i + parent-instance hook ids; the data-adx-slot placeholder is DROPPED in composed output (still emitted in standalone compile). html.ts emitSlot consults state.slots (SlotContext{projected,emitParent,parentScope}).
- CSS dedupe: compileInstance folds composed-children CSS into inst.css ONLY on the standalone (own-build) path; when a SHARED build is passed (page), inst.css is the component's OWN css only and compilePage emits one CSS block per distinct abs dir from build.order (no double-count). Same-basename deps in different folders never collide because child scopeId uses scopeLocation(repoRoot, childAbsDir).
- Error strings (verbatim): `[ADX] structure.adx:<line> - Unknown component "<tag>" (not an HTML element; add to manifest deps)`; `[ADX] manifest.json - Dependency not found: "<dep>"`; `[ADX] structure.adx:<line> - Dependency cycle: a -> b -> a`; `[ADX] structure.adx:<line> - Component "<tag>" has no slot "x"`; `[ADX] structure.adx:<line> - Duplicate slot content for "x"`.
- Fixtures added: fixtures/compose/landing (parent composing site-header default slot + user-card actions slot, with parent-owned projected {{who}} + @event) and fixtures/compose/emitter (a reusable child that emits a DISTINCT event name 'ping' on click — used for the same-component-twice HIGH-1/HIGH-2 tests; user-card could NOT be reused there because it emits 'click' which re-triggers its own click listener = infinite loop). Cycle/unknown/dep-missing/slot-error fixtures are generated in tmp dirs inside test/compose.test.ts.
- Tests: test/compose.test.ts (17 — composition splice/isolation, zero {{, CSS-once, per-instance i0/i1/i2, MEDIUM-3 parent-owned projection, HIGH-1 two instances distinct ids + own setup, HIGH-2 2nd-instance emit targets 2nd root via jsdom, dep-table resolve + Unknown/Dependency-not-found, 1/2/3-node cycles, slot-not-declared + duplicate-slot). Updated test/html-emit.test.ts (ids now `${scope}-i0-<n>`, root carries data-adx-i=i0) and test/glue-emit.test.ts (per-instance INSTANCES/HOOKS/HANDLERS loop assertions). 148 tests pass (131 prior + 17 new), tsc clean.
- NOTE: single-file eslint is clean but multi-file `npm run lint` is prohibitively slow in this worktree (type-aware service re-init per invocation); not run to completion. FEAT-003 verification is `npm run build` + `npm test`, both green. Docs NOT touched (doc-sync is FEAT-006). The single-component build path composes children into inst.css/body but the single-component CLI only writes ONE behavior.js/glue.js, so a STANDALONE build that composes children does not yet emit child behavior/glue sidecars — composition's full multi-file output is the PAGE path; flagged for FEAT-006 docs.
